enchantments.tooltip: Proof Against Poison +7: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +7 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 8 + their Fortitude save).

Proof Against Disease +7: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural diseases. This item also grants a +7 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical diseases, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical diseases with a DC of less than 8 + their Fortitude save).
Quality Fortitude Save +2: This item gives a +2 Quality bonus to your Fortitude saves.
Speed +28%: +28% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 13% bonus to attack speed.
Mythic Boot Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
